description: Transcription by instantiating the named maximum at the actual accessible world and introducing that pair as a witness. Structural witness selection from the named-individual conclusion, not a second philosophical derivation. Actual reflexivity selects the standpoint as an accessible world, and the named conclusion supplies n's presence there and its bound on every existing accessible-world pair. This constructs a witness of possible global attainment. Possible attainment is strictly weaker in the tested controls than n attaining a global bound at every accessible world; it is not a value bridge or a formalization of source steps1–5 as a whole. No independent premise defense or root-premise change is claimed. Focused axiom inspection reports no Lean axioms; excluded middle remains an explicit input of the main derivation and guarded adapter. The Comparator profile allows the approved Mathlib three only.
